# ntrl.ntis.gov fixtures

Hand-written in the shape of the JSF/PrimeFaces pages observed on 2026-09-14: page 1 of a search (server-rendered rows with `data-rk`, the `(1 - 2 of 3)` paginator, a ViewState), the DataTable pagination partial-response for page 2 (requires the session cookie and the ViewState from page 1), three title-detail pages (one without the Download action), and NTRL's own download POST answering an empty 200 — the site's real behaviour.
